name: Aru Hi no Fuukei EX
source:
Azusa & Chihaya are C rank idols who perform as a duo "URGENT". Main character is their producer. After shooting a special program about hot springs for local TV the cast stays at the inn for the night. Chihaya crawls into protagonist's room and asks for a kiss. What should he do?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
梓和千早是C级偶像，以二人组“URGENT”的形式进行表演。主角是他们的制作人。为当地电视台拍摄一个有关温泉的特别节目后，演员们在旅馆过夜。千早爬进主角的房间并索要一个吻。他该怎么办？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
